    # =====================================================================
    # EXPERIMENT REPLICATION: Triplicate 8-point 1:2 serial dilution series
    #
    # FIGURES BOUND:
    #   - Dilution curve: relative concentration vs. column index (1-8),
    #     generated in triplicate (rows A-C) on the destination plate.
    #
    # CLAIMS BOUND:
    #   - Automated serial transfer yields a reproducible 2-fold dilution
    #     factor per step across independent replicate rows.
    #   - Diluent delivery from a shared trough channel is uniform across
    #     replicate wells.
    #   - Fresh-tip-per-step eliminates cross-contamination between
    #     dilution points.
    #
    # LIMITATIONS:
    #   - 50 uL tip capacity constrains single aspirates to <= 40 uL,
    #     limiting working volumes to the low-microliter regime.
    #   - No on-deck waste reservoir: excess final volume (column 8 holds
    #     2x working volume) remains in the plate.
    #   - No on-deck readout available; verifying the dilution curve
    #     (e.g., absorbance) must be performed off-deck.
    # =====================================================================

    from itertools import product

    # --- Resource setup --------------------------------------------------
    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    dest = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")
    reagents = lh.get_resource("reagent_trough")

    # --- Experimental parameters -----------------------------------------
    WORKING_VOL = 40         # uL per transfer (safety margin under 50 uL tips)
    MIX_VOL = 30             # uL mixing volume (below well working volume)
    MIX_REPS = 3             # mix cycles for homogenization
    DILUENT_CHANNEL = "A1"   # trough channel holding diluent/buffer
    SERIES_ROWS = ["A", "B", "C"]       # triplicate dilution series
    DILUTION_COLS = list(range(1, 9))   # 8-point series, columns 1-8

    # Sanity check: never exceed tip capacity
    assert WORKING_VOL <= 45, "Working volume exceeds 50 uL tip safety margin"

    # Sequential tip allocator (column-major traversal of the tip rack)
    tip_cycle = (tip_rack[f"{r}{c}"]
                 for r, c in product("ABCDEFGH", range(1, 13)))

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 1: Pre-mix samples in the source plate (homogeneity claim)
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    for row in SERIES_ROWS:
        src_well = source[f"{row}1"]
        await lh.pick_up_tips(next(tip_cycle))
        await lh.mix(src_well, vols=[MIX_VOL], repetitions=MIX_REPS)
        await lh.drop_tips()
        print(f"Source well {row}1 pre-mixed for homogeneity.")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 2: Dispense diluent into columns 2-8 of each series row
    #         (single tip per row; re-aspirate from trough between wells)
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    for row in SERIES_ROWS:
        await lh.pick_up_tips(next(tip_cycle))
        for col in DILUTION_COLS[1:]:  # skip column 1 (pure-sample point)
            await lh.aspirate(reagents[DILUENT_CHANNEL], vols=[WORKING_VOL])
            await lh.dispense(dest[f"{row}{col}"], vols=[WORKING_VOL])
        await lh.drop_tips()
        print(f"Diluent ({WORKING_VOL} uL) delivered to row {row}, columns 2-8.")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 3: Load pure sample into column 1 of each series row (100% point)
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    for row in SERIES_ROWS:
        await lh.pick_up_tips(next(tip_cycle))
        await lh.aspirate(source[f"{row}1"], vols=[WORKING_VOL])
        await lh.dispense(dest[f"{row}1"], vols=[WORKING_VOL])
        await lh.drop_tips()
        print(f"Sample loaded into {row}1 (100% concentration point).")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 4: Serial 1:2 dilution transfers (column i -> column i+1)
    #         Fresh tip per step to support the no-carryover claim.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    for row in SERIES_ROWS:
        for i in range(len(DILUTION_COLS) - 1):
            src_well = dest[f"{row}{DILUTION_COLS[i]}"]
            dst_well = dest[f"{row}{DILUTION_COLS[i + 1]}"]
            await lh.pick_up_tips(next(tip_cycle))
            # Homogenize source well before withdrawing the aliquot
            await lh.mix(src_well, vols=[MIX_VOL], repetitions=MIX_REPS)
            await lh.aspirate(src_well, vols=[WORKING_VOL])
            await lh.dispense(dst_well, vols=[WORKING_VOL])
            await lh.drop_tips()
            print(f"{row}: 1:2 dilution {DILUTION_COLS[i]} -> "
                  f"{DILUTION_COLS[i + 1]} complete.")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Summary: figures, claims, and limitations bound by this run
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    print("=== REPLICATION SUMMARY ===")
    print("FIGURES: 8-point 1:2 dilution curve (columns 1-8), "
          "triplicate series in rows A-C of destination plate.")
    print("CLAIMS: reproducible 2-fold dilution factor per step; uniform "
          "diluent delivery from shared trough; no cross-contamination "
          "(fresh tip per serial step).")
    print("LIMITATIONS: working volume capped at 40 uL (50 uL tip limit); "
          "no on-deck waste (column 8 retains 2x volume); curve "
          "verification requires off-deck readout.")

    print("--- PROTOCOL_SUCCESS ---")

    # =====================================================================
    # EXPERIMENT REPLICATION: Triplicate 8-point 1:2 serial dilution series
    #
    # FIGURES BOUND:
    #   - Dilution curve: relative concentration vs. column index (1-8)
    #     for triplicate series in rows A-C of the destination plate.
    #
    # CLAIMS BOUND:
    #   - Automated serial transfer produces a reproducible 2-fold
    #     dilution factor per step across independent replicate rows.
    #   - Reagent (diluent) addition from a shared trough is uniform
    #     across replicate wells.
    #
    # LIMITATIONS:
    #   - 50 uL tip capacity caps single aspirates at <= 40 uL, so
    #     working volumes are constrained to the low-uL regime.
    #   - No waste reservoir is configured, so final excess volumes
    #     (column 8, 2x working volume) remain in the plate.
    #   - No on-deck readout (e.g., absorbance) is available; downstream
    #     verification of the dilution curve must be done off-deck.
    # =====================================================================

    from itertools import product

    # --- Resource setup -------------------------------------------------
    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    dest = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")
    reagents = lh.get_resource("reagent_trough")

    # --- Experimental parameters ----------------------------------------
    WORKING_VOL = 40        # uL per transfer (safe margin under 50 uL tips)
    MIX_VOL = 30            # uL mixing volume (below working volume)
    MIX_REPS = 3            # mix cycles for homogenization
    DILUENT_CHANNEL = "A1"  # trough channel holding diluent/buffer
    SERIES_ROWS = ["A", "B", "C"]     # triplicate dilution series
    DILUTION_COLS = list(range(1, 9))  # 8-point series across columns 1-8

    # Sequential tip allocator (column-major order through the rack)
    tip_cycle = (tip_rack[f"{r}{c}"]
                 for r, c in product("ABCDEFGH", range(1, 13)))

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 1: Pre-mix samples in the source plate (homogeneity claim)
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    for row in SERIES_ROWS:
        src_well = source[f"{row}1"]
        tip = next(tip_cycle)
        await lh.pick_up_tips(tip)
        await lh.mix(src_well, vols=[MIX_VOL], repetitions=MIX_REPS)
        await lh.drop_tips()
        print(f"Source well {row}1 pre-mixed.")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 2: Dispense diluent into columns 2-8 of each series row
    #         (one tip reused per row; re-aspirate between dispenses)
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    for row in SERIES_ROWS:
        tip = next(tip_cycle)
        await lh.pick_up_tips(tip)
        for col in DILUTION_COLS[1:]:  # skip column 1 (pure sample)
            dest_well = dest[f"{row}{col}"]
            await lh.aspirate(reagents[DILUENT_CHANNEL], vols=[WORKING_VOL])
            await lh.dispense(dest_well, vols=[WORKING_VOL])
        await lh.drop_tips()
        print(f"Diluent dispensed into row {row}, columns 2-8.")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 3: Load pure sample into column 1 of each series row
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    for row in SERIES_ROWS:
        tip = next(tip_cycle)
        await lh.pick_up_tips(tip)
        await lh.aspirate(source[f"{row}1"], vols=[WORKING_VOL])
        await lh.dispense(dest[f"{row}1"], vols=[WORKING_VOL])
        await lh.drop_tips()
        print(f"Sample loaded into {row}1 (100% concentration point).")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 4: Serial 1:2 dilution transfers (column i -> column i+1)
    #         Fresh tip per step to bind the no-carryover claim.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    for row in SERIES_ROWS:
        for i in range(len(DILUTION_COLS) - 1):
            src_well = dest[f"{row}{DILUTION_COLS[i]}"]
            dst_well = dest[f"{row}{DILUTION_COLS[i + 1]}"]
            tip = next(tip_cycle)
            await lh.pick_up_tips(tip)
            await lh.mix(src_well, vols=[MIX_VOL], repetitions=MIX_REPS)
            await lh.aspirate(src_well, vols=[WORKING_VOL])
            await lh.dispense(dst_well, vols=[WORKING_VOL])
            await lh.drop_tips()
            print(f"{row}: 1:2 dilution {DILUTION_COLS[i]} -> {DILUTION_COLS[i+1]} complete.")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Summary: figures, claims, and limitations bound by this run
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    print("=== REPLICATION SUMMARY ===")
    print("FIGURES: 8-point 1:2 dilution curve (cols 1-8), triplicate rows A-C.")
    print("CLAIMS: reproducible 2-fold dilution factor per step; uniform "
          "diluent delivery; no cross-contamination (fresh tip per step).")
    print("LIMITATIONS: <= 40 uL working volume (50 uL tip cap); no on-deck "
          "waste (col 8 holds 2x volume); verification requires off-deck readout.")

    print("--- PROTOCOL_SUCCESS ---")
